comments.body:
RESOLVED (RED->GREEN, replicated).

Fix: added rebar.llm.model_classes.primary_endpoint_for(resolved) (mirrors fallback_targets_for) and, at the single chokepoint runner.run, when cfg.base_url is unset, recover the matching class slot's endpoint from the resolved model string and apply it as cfg.base_url. This registers rebar's OpenAI-compatible builder for the PRIMARY model, stamps the endpoint host into signed provenance, and flips tier=best_effort — uniformly with the top-level REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL path. No-op when no slot endpoint matches or base_url is already set; the model_override (offline TestModel) path is exempt.

RED->GREEN: tests/unit/test_openai_compatible_provider.py::test_per_class_endpoint_routes_the_primary_through_the_local_builder failed with 'Missing credentials' (stock OpenAIProvider, model=openai:local-model) before the fix; passes after. Full guard: 113 provider/runner/model-class tests + 98 runner-hardening/qualifier + 140 enrich/screen/overlap tests all green; make lint + make typecheck clean; both edited modules under the 800 LOC cap.

Replicated original report: enrich(text=...) with REBAR_LLM_TRIVIAL_ENDPOINT set and NO REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL now returns a schema-valid ticket_digest end-to-end against the real local MLX server (~39s), where it previously raised LLMUnavailableError: Missing credentials.

Docs: docs/llm-framework.md updated — the per-class endpoint recipe is restored as working alongside the top-level base_url recipe, plus a validated local-model worked example.

compiled_state.description:
ROOT CAUSE (proven, cited).

Symptom: pointing a model class at a local OpenAI-compatible server via the documented per-class endpoint — TOML 'trivial = { model=..., provider="openai", endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1" }' or env REBAR_LLM_TRIVIAL_ENDPOINT=... — fails at run time with 'openai.OpenAIError: Missing credentials' (pydantic-ai's stock OpenAIProvider), instead of using rebar's OpenAI-compatible builder (which supplies api_key='not-needed' and withdraws supports_json_schema_output).

Mechanism: ClassSlot.endpoint is parsed (src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py _parse_slot, with dedicated env vars REBAR_LLM_{FRONTIER,STANDARD,TRIVIAL}_ENDPOINT) and documented (docs/llm-framework.md), but the ONLY consumer of any '.endpoint' is build_fallback_model (model_classes.py:403), which reads t.endpoint from FALLBACK targets only and hardcodes the PRIMARY candidate's endpoint to None. resolve_class / resolve_model_string return only 'provider:model', discarding the slot endpoint. Every op collapses the class onto cfg via replace(cfg, model=resolve_model_string(CLASS)) (enrich.py:82, epic_bug_screen.py:109, overlap/judge, plan_review, completion, code_review, workflow/runs), so cfg.base_url stays None. In runner.run, ProviderSession(cfg) then does NOT register the openai builder (it is registered only when cfg.base_url is set), so the primary takes the is_resolvable() lazy-string branch (runner.py ~381) and Agent(model_string) is built by pydantic-ai with no provider_factory -> stock OpenAIProvider -> requires OPENAI_API_KEY -> fails.

Authoritative contract violated: docs/llm-framework.md documents the per-class endpoint recipe as a working way to reach a local server, and the env table lists REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_ENDPOINT as 'per-class OpenAI-compatible endpoint'.

Only working recipe today: top-level REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL (registers the builder + flips signed tier to best_effort). VALIDATED end-to-end against a local MLX server: enrich() returned a valid ticket_digest in ~35s.

FIX (planned): at the single chokepoint runner.run — mirroring fallback_targets_for(resolved) — look up the slot whose primary resolves to 'resolved' and, when cfg.base_url is unset, apply that slot's endpoint to cfg.base_url so the builder registers, provenance records the host, and the tier flips to best_effort uniformly. RED->GREEN with a runner-level test.

ACCEPTANCE: a class slot / REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_ENDPOINT with provider=openai and NO REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL routes the primary model through rebar's OpenAI-compatible builder (no OPENAI_API_KEY required); provenance base_url is set and tier=best_effort; existing base_url and fallback-endpoint behavior unchanged.
